newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG wins Irish road construction orders.
newsitem.headline: HBG wins Irish road construction orders.

text.p: Construction firm Hollandsche Beton Groep NV said on Tuesday its Irish subsidiary Ascon had won road construction orders with a total value of 95 million guilders.
Ascon will build part of a motorway 50 kilometres south of Dublin which is due to be ready in 1999. The HBG unit's part of the contract is 67 million guilders.

A joint venture of Ascon and Irish engineering group SIAC will build, south of the Irish capital, a motorway which is to be completed in September 1997. Ascon's contract sum for this second project is 28 million guilders, HBG said in a statement.
